name: Buy-Write
summary: Buy the 100 shares and sell the call in one combined net-debit order, so the entry price of the covered call unit is locked as a single fill.

legs.strike_rule: market/limit at the combo net debit
0.30-0.40 delta OTM, or ATM for a maximum-income variant

max_profit: (strike x 100) - net debit paid for the combo
breakevens: net debit / 100 (i.e. share price minus premium)
when_to_use: Establishing a new income position from scratch rather than overwriting existing shares. Preferred whenever the system is initiating, because it removes leg risk and prices the unit by its true net basis.
entry_rules: Submit as a single multi-leg net-debit order (Alpaca supports multi-leg up to 4 legs); do NOT leg in.
Require net debit <= (spot x 100) - (0.6% x spot x 100), i.e. the credit covers at least 0.6% of notional.
Require static return (credit / net debit) >= 1.2% for a 30-45 DTE cycle, and if-called return >= 2.5%.
Require IV Rank >= 30 and no earnings inside the option's life.
Size so that net debit <= 8% of account equity per underlying (at ~$50k equity that is ~$4,000 per unit).
Reject if the combined order's implied share price is more than 0.3% worse than the current share NBBO mid.
management_rules: Close at 50% of the option credit, or unwind the whole combo at 60% of max profit, whichever the config specifies.
At 21 DTE, roll the call or unwind the combo.
If the stock drops below net debit basis x 0.90, either roll the call down for credit or exit the unit; do not average down inside the same unit.
Track the position as one unit with an adjusted basis: basis = net debit - all subsequent net call credits.
exit_rules: Unwind as a single net-credit combo order (sell stock + buy call) to avoid a naked leg.
HARD: if the call is ITM at 15:30 ET on expiration day, buy it back and decide separately whether to keep the shares.
Close the call if extrinsic < 0.05 and delta > 0.85 at any time.
Ex-dividend guard identical to the covered call.
assignment_risk: Same as covered call: the short call is assignable, worst around ex-dividend when extrinsic < dividend, and at expiration when ITM. Shares cover the delivery, so the risk is unwanted disposal, not undefined loss.
buying_power: Net debit in cash (paper cash account) or ~50% Reg-T initial margin on the share leg for a margin account; the call adds no requirement while covered.
liquidity_needs: Needs a tradable combo: option OI >= 250, option spread <= 8% of mid, share spread <= 0.05%.
common_mistakes: Legging in and getting a bad share fill; chasing the highest premium name (usually the highest realized-vol name) and losing on the shares; ignoring the if-called return and writing strikes that make the unit unprofitable even when everything works.
zero_dte_notes: Buying shares to write a 0DTE call gives almost no premium against full overnight-free but full intraday share risk; the share leg dominates. Only sensible if the shares are wanted anyway.
family: Stock/ETF Shares Combined With Options (covered writes, protective hedges, collars, synthetics, repairs, conversions)
